translations: And certainly We have made easy
puzzle.hint: This verse appears four times in Surah Al-Qamar, emphasizing the accessibility of the Qur'an for reflection and reminder.
puzzle.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
puzzle.verseEn: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
